policy_source: User-confirmed rules in this chat on 2026-10-29, fixed before inference.

category_definitions.WELLNESS: Candidate wellness products or services: fitness, exercise or health products/services, gym memberships, identified fitness trackers, AirPods, headphones and workout audio accessories. Audio accessories qualify as candidate Wellness by product identity alone; the invoice need not mention gym or workout intent. Do not evaluate employee purpose, explanation, final eligibility or reimbursement. If a specific claimed line is identified, classify that line only; otherwise classify the entire described purchase. A description containing multiple independently relevant products/services that cannot all be represented by Wellness is MIXED_ITEMS, not Wellness.
category_definitions.SMARTPHONE: A smartphone handset, excluding tablets, watches, headphones, other accessories and mobile service charges. If a specific claimed line is identified, classify that line only; otherwise classify the entire described purchase. Independently relevant products/services spanning categories are MIXED_ITEMS, not Smartphone.
category_definitions.BROADBAND: Fixed home or office internet service charges, excluding mobile service and device purchases. If a specific claimed line is identified, classify that line only; otherwise classify the entire described purchase. Independently relevant products/services spanning categories are MIXED_ITEMS, not Broadband.
category_definitions.MOBILE_BILL: Cellular voice or mobile data service charges, excluding device purchases and fixed broadband. A mobile plan with Netflix included at no separately stated charge remains MOBILE_BILL. Netflix with a separate charge is a separate product/service: a description claiming both is MIXED_ITEMS; a specifically claimed mobile-service line alone remains MOBILE_BILL. Do not calculate eligible amounts or reimbursement. If a specific claimed line is identified, classify that line only; otherwise classify the entire described purchase.
category_definitions.BUSINESS_HOTEL: Hotel or other temporary lodging service. Classify service identity without requiring or inferring business purpose. If a specific claimed line is identified, classify that line only; otherwise classify the entire described purchase. Independently relevant products/services spanning categories are MIXED_ITEMS, not Business Hotel.
category_definitions.BUSINESS_TRANSPORT: Passenger travel service such as taxi, rail, bus or airfare. Classify service identity without requiring or inferring business purpose. If a specific claimed line is identified, classify that line only; otherwise classify the entire described purchase. Independently relevant products/services spanning categories are MIXED_ITEMS, not Business Transport.
category_definitions.OTHER: An adequately identified item/service outside all six reimbursement categories, such as a tablet or a separately charged streaming subscription. Do not use OTHER merely because employee purpose is absent. If a specific claimed line is identified, classify that line only; otherwise classify the entire described purchase. Multiple independently relevant products/services for which one category cannot represent the entire claimed purchase are MIXED_ITEMS.
category_definitions.INSUFFICIENT_INFORMATION: Use only when the invoice description does not adequately identify what was purchased, such as a bare brand name or unspecified subscription. Missing employee justification or purpose is never a reason for this label. An explicitly identified mixed purchase is MIXED_ITEMS, not INSUFFICIENT_INFORMATION. If a specific claimed line is identified, classify that line only.
category_definitions.MIXED_ITEMS: The description explicitly contains multiple independently relevant products/services and one category cannot represent the entire described purchase. This includes separately charged mobile service plus Netflix, or a smartphone plus headphones. Do not treat an included Netflix benefit with no separately stated charge as a separate purchase: that mobile plan is MOBILE_BILL. If a specific claimed invoice line is identified, classify only that claimed item/service even when other invoice lines are mentioned. This label signals item-level separation, not insufficient product identity; do not calculate reimbursement or assess purpose.
